map.⚠️ 本工具仅作膳食营养估算参考，不替代营养师/医生的个体化营养治疗。孕期、慢性: ⚠️ This tool serves only as a reference for dietary nutrition estimates and does not replace individualized nutrition therapy from a nutritionist or physician. map.每日总消耗（TDEE）= BMR × 活动系数。: Daily total expenditure (TDEE) = BMR × the activity factor.
map.蛋白质按 1.8 g/kg 体重估算，脂肪占 25%，剩余热量为碳水化合物。: Protein is estimated at 1.8 g/kg of body weight, fat takes 25%, and the remaining calories go to carbohydrate.

map.久坐 1.2、轻度 1.375、中度 1.55、高度 1.725、极高 1.9；: Sedentary 1.2, light 1.375, moderate 1.55, high 1.725, very high 1.9. The same BMR of 1577.5 gives only 1893 with 1.2 but reaches 2997 with 1.9, a difference of about 1100 kcal.
map.BMR 用哪个公式准？: Which BMR Formula Is More Accurate?
map.Mifflin-St Jeor 比哈里斯-本尼迪克特更贴近现代人；男 +5、女: Mifflin-St Jeor fits modern people better than Harris-Benedict. It adds 5 for men and subtracts 161 for women, and takes age, height (cm) and weight (kg) as inputs.
map.蛋白 1.8 g/kg 适合谁？: Who Is Protein at 1.8 g/kg Suited For?
map.运动/增肌人群常用 1.6–2.2 g/kg；久坐普通成人约 0.8–1.0 g: Athletes and people gaining muscle commonly use 1.6 to 2.2 g/kg, while sedentary adults need only about 0.8 to 1.0 g/kg, and people with kidney disease should lower it under medical advice.
